findings.what: The request log keeps every exchange, with full headers and bodies, for the life of the page. It has no cap, and publish() re-copies the whole array on each send and each answer.
findings.why: Hardening only, carried from A4. The log is memory-only and holds no cookies or auth. It grows without bound in a long session. WB-7 asks for no cap, so this does not block. David's ruling D1 carries it to U8.
